architecture_decisions:
:
- The approved Work Specification and exact acceptance IDs remain authoritative.
- `ImplementationContentProposal`, server-canonicalized `ImplementationProposal`, `GeneratedSourcePatch`, `SourcePatch`, `CanonicalizingTextPatchEngine`, `ProposalSafetyPreflight`, and `SafeImplementationEngine` remain the canonical generation and source-safety contracts.
- P2-V0.23.27 per-file and per-work-unit incremental convergence remains in place.
- Before a work unit is marked complete, the runtime must preflight the already completed plan-prefix patches plus that work unit's candidate proposal.
- A plan-prefix rejection is attributed only to the current work-unit generation for recovery purposes.
- Already completed work-unit intent remains unchanged and non-authoritative.
- The plan-prefix safe-preflight reason is obtained only from the existing server-owned sanitized reason seam.
- A plan-prefix rejection consumes the same existing candidate recovery path: remaining distinct admitted agents first, then…

AC-01: validate protected requirement — The P2-V0.23.27 workstream/current-state record states that the authenticated run exposed a later post-generation/pre-BUILD blocker at durable sequence #86 and does not claim BUILD progression.

AC-02: validate protected requirement — A current work-unit proposal that is locally safe but fails when combined with prior completed work-unit patches is rejected before the work unit enters `completed`.
AC-03: validate protected requirement — A plan-prefix rejection never mutates, removes, or overwrites patches already admitted from completed work units.
AC-04: validate protected requirement — A plan-prefix rejection advances through the existing distinct admitted-agent recovery path and can converge on a later safe current-unit proposal.
AC-05: validate protected requirement — After distinct agents are exhausted, at most one existing validator-repair generation is available for the work unit. No additional retry is introduced.

AC-06: validate protected requirement — If every bounded current-unit generation continues to fail plan-prefix preflight, IMPLEMENT fails closed without canonical mutation and with `CANDIDATE_GENERATION_EXHAUSTED` evidence.

AC-07: validate protected requirement — Even after plan-prefix-aware convergence, the final combined proposal still passes through exact acceptance validation and the unchanged full safe preflight before candidate BUILD/TEST/VERIFY.

AC-08: validate protected requirement — Only a fully converged final proposal may enter disposable protected BUILD/TEST/VERIFY and independent evaluation. Prefix preflight success is not functional correctness evidence.

AC-09: validate protected requirement — A valid bounded `candidate_generation_failure` envelope is preserved through `ImplementationContractError.diagnostic_evidence` and durable failed IMPLEMENT evidence.

AC-10: validate protected requirement — Unknown fields, arbitrary reason strings, source/generated text, diffs, exception text, provider payloads, filesystem roots, credentials, tokens, environment values, or true authority claims cannot survive `_bounded_implementation_failure_evidence()`.

AC-11: validate protected requirement — Traversal, secrets, symlinks, unsupported extensions, stale source, collisions, nested source creation, hierarchy conflicts, aggregate limits, patch canonicalization, source-lineage, candidate validation, and final mutation regressions remain green.

AC-12: validate protected requirement — Luna/Terra/Sol, 60-second hosted timeout, zero hidden provider retries, distinct-agent recovery ceiling, one final validator repair, request-level autonomy budget, and competition limits remain unchanged.

AC-13: validate protected requirement — Focused P2-V0.23.28 tests, full API regression, applicable client checks, protected promotion evaluation, Bounded Autonomy Pilot, Workstream Spec Validation, and required DSPy compile/verify pass on the exact reviewed head.

AC-14: validate protected requirement — After merge, the exact application source is READY on the production API; canonical `/health` and `/ready` return HTTP 200 with database/providers ready; runtime warning/error/fatal verification is clean.

AC-15: validate protected requirement — A user-authenticated retry of Engineering Run `3a1ba66a-5649-42b6-81ee-91684fe06bbc` or equivalent exact work either enters disposable BUILD/TEST/VERIFY after plan-prefix-aware convergence or exposes a still-later bounded blocker with preserved server-owned diagnostic evidence. A generic `AUTONOMOUS_IMPLEMENT_FAILED` with the new diagnostic envelope silently dropped fails this criterion.

- The approved Work Specification and exact acceptance IDs remain authoritative.
- `ImplementationContentProposal`, server-canonicalized `ImplementationProposal`, `GeneratedSourcePatch`, `SourcePatch`, `CanonicalizingTextPatchEngine`, `ProposalSafetyPreflight`, and `SafeImplementationEngine` remain the canonical generation and source-safety contracts.
- P2-V0.23.27 per-file and per-work-unit incremental convergence remains in place.
- Before a work-unit proposal can be rejected, the runtime must preflight the already completed plan-prefix patches plus that work unit's candidate proposal.
